Game Overview

In Vault Hopper, the core idea is straightforward: leap into danger with Vault Hopper, where you play as a swift thief navigating treacherous vaults. With fast-paced jumping, dodging deadly traps, and collecting glimmering coins, your reflexes are your best ally. Stay on your toes to survive this adrenaline-pumping adventure. Can you master the vault?
